title: The projection formula for capping with a Chern class and flat pullback
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for an arbitrary Chern class against flat pullback (statement lines 7439-7450, tag 02SK-adjacent). The proof records the characterising relation for the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes, pulls that relation back along the morphism between the projective bundles using compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class and with composition of flat pullbacks, and identifies the result by the uniqueness in the characterisation. The pullback of the relation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
